messages:
support-julia: Customer reports intermittent 502s from hosted inference gateway since ~09:12 UTC. Also flagged duplicate billing — customer retried after intermittent errors and was charged twice. Request example and logs attached. SUP-3245 INC-8812
eli: Can you paste the gateway request_id and a sample X-Request-ID? Need to correlate with billing ledger.
support-julia: request_id=rgw-20260315-7f9c, X-Request-ID=6a3b2c. Logs show 502s from gateway and upstream control-plane 5xx for session validation.
raj_infra: Quick check — configdb latency spike around 09:11-09:14 UTC, lots of timeouts to routing-policy service. That would make control-plane return 5xx which the gateway maps to 502. :thinking_face:
matt_runtime: If routing-policy returns 5xx while validating session/auth we currently return 502 and do not instruct client to retry idempotently. We also don't dedupe at gateway for same request body unless client sends Idempotency-Key.
sophia_prodops: Customer didn't set Idempotency-Key. Their client retries aggressively (no backoff). So they hit duplicated successful inference after fallback — causing double billing.
support-julia: Customer asked for repro steps so they can patch client. Can we provide a safe curl repro that reproduces the 502 + retry behavior (without actual charge)?
eli: Use a debug flag that forces routing-policy timeouts on non-prod. Repro curl:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Debug-Force-Routing-Timeout: true" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: repro-6a3b2c" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
```
That will return 502 on first attempt, then if client retries immediately it will sometimes succeed when control-plane recovers.
raj_infra: Mitigation ideas:
- Short-term: add gateway-level soft-dedupe on X-Request-ID for 10s window for hosted API (fast to roll out)
- Customer-facing: advise idempotency header and exponential backoff
- Infra: investigate why configdb had timeouts (I/O saturation) and patch.
matt_runtime: I can push a canary to enable 10s dedupe for POST /v1/generate in hosted-gateway. Need approval from oncall and product for billing edge-case.
sophia_prodops: Approve canary for 10% traffic. Also create billing fencing rule to reconcile near-duplicate successful tokens for the affected timeframe (09:10-09:20 UTC) to avoid charging customers twice automatically.
oncall-bot: @oncall-triggered Incident INC-8812 created and assigned to eng-infra. Pager duty alerted.
support-julia: I'll send customer repro + recommended quick fixes: set Idempotency-Key, add exponential backoff (500, 1s, 2s, 4s), and contact support if they see duplicated charges — we'll reconcile.
eli: Follow-up tasks:
- raj_infra: dig into configdb I/O and put mitigation in place (INC-8812)
- matt_runtime: canary dedupe rollout (10%)
- sophia_prodops: billing reconciliation rules and customer outreach
I'll update the ticket with timelines.
support-julia: Thank you — keeping customer posted. :thumbsup:
